title: Bicycle with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx='22' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#33E0FF' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='68' r='16' fill='none' stroke='#33E0FF' stroke-width='5'/>

  <circle cx='22' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='68' r='3' fill='#FFD23F'/>

  <line x1='22' y1='52' x2='22' y2='84' stroke='#7CF7A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='6' y1='68' x2='38' y2='68' stroke='#7CF7A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='11' y1='57' x2='33' y2='79' stroke='#7CF7A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='33' y1='57' x2='11' y2='79' stroke='#7CF7A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='78' y1='52' x2='78' y2='84' stroke='#7CF7A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='68' x2='94' y2='68' stroke='#7CF7A0' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <line x1='22' y1='68' x2='50' y2='68' stroke='#FF5C8A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='68' x2='50' y2='42' stroke='#FF5C8A' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- seat post and seat -->
  <line x1='50' y1='42' x2='46' y2='30' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <line x1='78' y1='68' x2='74' y2='40' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='37' x2='82' y2='37' stroke='#FFB347' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='68' r='4' fill='#FFD23F'/>

  <rect x='52' y='56' width='10' height='4' rx='1.5' fill='#FFD23F'/>
  <!-- smiling face on frame -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <path d='M36 58 Q48 68 60 58' fill='none' stroke='#FFFFFF' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='57' r='2' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='57' r='2' fill='#FF9EC4'/>
